name: Reply to Alice - Sick Child (v2)
description: User asks for inbox summary, then replies to Alice about child being sick - using new validator system

steps.user_message: Can you please summarize all my emails
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should read all emails and provide a summary

steps.user_message: Okay thanks, can you reply to alice saying that I cannot make it to the meeting tomorrow because my child is sick
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should send a reply to Alice mentioning the sick child
